items.title: "투자 전 과정 ESG 내재화"…스틱인베, 책임투자 성과 인정받아

items.title: 인텔, 韓기업 23곳과 AI 동맹…국산 서버로 소버린 AI 공략

items.title: 제너셈, 3분기 수주잔고 지난해 매출 1.5배…영업익 흑자전환

items.title: LG생건 자회사 코카콜라음료 물류센터 공사 중 근로자 추락사고

items.title: 이준석 "이 대통령 연락 달라…20만호 공급 가능한 땅 있어"
items.snippet: 이준석 개혁신당 의원이 부동산 정책과 관련해 20만 호를 즉시 공급할 땅이 있다면서 정부가 공급 중심으로 정책을 전환하면 위치를 알려주겠다고 제안했습니다.이 의원은 오늘(12일) KBS라디오 '전격시사'에 출연해 현 정부가 추진 중인 공급 정책에 대해 "오세훈 서울시장이 열심히 하고 있는 재건축, 재개발을 통한 공급은 오늘부터 시작해도 5년 이상 걸린다"면서 바로 삽을 뜰 수 있는 부지가 필요하다고 강조했습니다.이어 "최근 저희 지역에 있는 의원 몇 분이랑 얘기하다가 한 20만 호 정도 즉시 공급할 수 있는 부지가 있다(는 의견이 나왔다)"며 "이 대통령께서 조세 규제 정책이 아닌 공급 정책으로 전환하겠다는 생각이 들면..

items.title: 장동혁 "조작기소 아닌 '조작수사 특검' 될 것…재판 재개해야"
items.snippet: 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 오늘(12일) 이재명 대통령 관련 사건이 수사 대상에 포함된 '조작기소 특검'을 앞두고 법원을 향해 "피고인 이재명이 자기 손으로 공소장을 찢기 전에 재판을 재개해야 한다"고 촉구했습니다.장 대표는 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 "재판을 미루다 '이재명 탈옥 프로젝트'가 성공하면 법원 역시 탈옥 공범으로 국민의 심판을 받을 것이다. 법원은 즉각 재판을 재개하길 바란다"며 이같이 말했습니다.그는 "결국 조작했다고 조작하지 않는 한 특검의 수사 자체가 불가능하다. 조작기소 특검이 아니라 조작수사 특검이 될 것"이라며 "어떤 결론을 내놓은들 국민은 믿지 않고 본인들만 법 왜곡죄에 걸려 감옥 가게 될 것..

items.snippet: 김정은 북한 국무위원장은 동해안 해군기지 건설사업 현장을 방문해 “현대적인 해군기지 건설이 철두철미 우리 국가의 안전, 해상주권 보위와 직결되는 중대 핵심사업”이라고 말했다.북한 노동당 기관지 노동신문은 김 위원장이 11일 “당 제9차 대회와 당중앙위원회 제9기 제2차 전원회의 결정에 따라 추진되고 있는 동해안의 중요 해군기지 건설사업을 현지에서 지도”했다고 12일 보도했다.김 위원장은 현대적 해군기지 건설이 “무조건 당 중앙이 결정한 기간 내에 당 중앙이 요구하는 질적 수준에서 완결되여야 한다”고 당부했다.이어 “기지의 현대화, 다기능화, 요새화를 철저히 실현하기 위한 전략적 요소들의 배치와 관련한 지침들을 제시”하고 “공사지휘 역량의 강력한 보강과 건설 역량의 증강을 비롯하여 군항 건설의 본격적인 진척을 위한 중요대책들을 포치(지시)”했다...

items.title: 한병도 “당청 엇박자 없다…더 나은 민생 위해 긴밀히 협력”
items.snippet: 한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 12일 “당·청 간 엇박자는 없다”며 “더 나은 민생을 위해 당과 정부가 긴밀히 협력하고 있다는 말씀을 확실히 드린다”고 강조했다.한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 정책조정회의에서 전날 이재명 대통령 초청으로 열린 당 지도부 만찬을 언급하며 이같이 말했다. 그는 “당은 양극화 극복과 소비 진작을 위해 정부의 과감하고 신속한 대책이 필요하다고 요청 드렸고, 대통령께서도 공감하시면서 한마음 한뜻으로 당·청이 움직여야 한다는 점을 강조하셨다”고 전했다.이어 “국민의힘이 정쟁에 매달릴 때 민주당과 이재명 정부는 민생에 매달리겠다”며 “국정과제와 민생입법에 속도를 내고 내년도 예산안도 법정 시한 안에 책임지고 처리하겠다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “오직 민생, 오직 국민만 바라보며 남은 정기국회에 총력을 다하겠다”고 덧붙였다....

items.snippet: 오세훈 서울시장이 11일 국민의힘 장동혁 대표 체제를 정면으로 겨누고 나섰다. 수도권 민심을 얻어야 한다며 비상대책위원회 체제 전환을 언급한 것. 장 대표가 연임 도전을 사실상 공식화한 가운데 보수 야권의 차기 주도권을 둘러싼 경쟁이 본격화됐다는 분석이 나온다.오 시장은 11일 페이스북을 통해 “수도권 민심을 얻기 위해서는 변화의 방식에 성역이나 한계를 둬서는 안 된다”며 “전당대회 전 비상대책위원회 체제로의 전환도 그중 하나”라고 밝혔다. 장 대표가 내년 8월 임기 만료 전 사퇴하고 당이 비대위 체제로 전환해야 한다는 것. 오 시장은 이어 무소속 한동훈 의원에 대해서도 “한 의원의 복당이 총선 승리를 위해 반드시 필요하다고 생각한다”고 적었다. 앞서 장 대표는 한 의원의 복당 요구를 일축한 바 있다.이에 장 대표는 기자들과 만나 “제가 서울...

items.title: “에너지 생산 책임져온 충남에 ‘발전공기업 통합 본사’ 유치”
items.snippet: 엄승용 보령시장이 ‘발전공기업 통합 본사 충남 유치 정책토론회’에 참석해 통합 본사의 충남 유치 당위성을 강조하고 도내 역량 결집을 호소했다. 10일 국회의원회관 제1세미나실에서 열린 토론회는 ‘국가 전력 정책 최적지 충남’을 주제로 마련됐다. 충남도와 성일종(서산·태안)·어기구(당진)·장동혁(보령·서천) 국회의원실이 공동 주최하고 충남연구원이 주관했다. 박수현 충남도지사와 도내 국회의원, 보령·당진 시장과 태안군수 등 100여 명이 참석했다. 이 자리에서 엄 시장은 “국가의 필요에 따라 에너지 생산을 책임져 온 지역이 전환의 부담까지 홀로 떠안아서는 안 된다”며 “충남의 희생과 기여가 정당하게 평가받고 새로운 성장 기반이 마련돼야 한다. 그 출발점이 바로 발전공기업 통합 본사의 충남 유치”라고 말했다. 이어 “경쟁 지역도 이미 유치에 총력을...

items.title: ‘농어촌기금 출연 기업 노력 의무화’ 여권 단독 처리
items.snippet: 국회 농림축산식품해양수산위원회가 11일 농어촌상생협력기금 출연에 대한 기업의 노력 의무를 명시한 ‘한미 자유무역협정(FTA) 체결에 따른 농어업인 등의 지원에 관한 특별법’을 여권 주도로 처리했다. 국민의힘은 농협중앙회장 선거를 조합원 직선제로 전환하도록 한 농협법 개정안 처리에 반발하며 이날 회의에 불참했다. 국회 농해수위는 이날 오후 국회에서 전체회의를 열고 FTA 농어업법을 여권 단독으로 의결했다. 내년 종료될 예정이었던 기금 조성 기간을 10년 연장하고 일정 수준 이상 FTA로 수혜를 보는 기업들에 매년 기금을 출연하도록 노력 의무를 부과하는 것을 골자로 한다. 농어촌상생협력기금은 FTA 이행으로 피해를 입은 농어업인의 지속가능한 발전과 농어촌·민간기업 간 상생협력 촉진을 위한 사업을 추진하기 위해 2017년 조성됐다. 10년 동안 매...

items.title: ‘빨간펜 메모’ 읽은 이용철, 공소취소 질문에 또 “진상규명 먼저”
items.snippet: 이용철 법무부 장관 후보자가 11일 이재명 대통령이 기소된 사건의 공소 취소 지휘 여부에 대해 “(조작기소 특검의) 진상 규명이 시작되지도 않았는데 예측, 예단과 억측을 전제로 한 논란에 의견을 드리는 건 적절치 않다”고 밝혔다. 이 후보자는 이날 서울 송파구 인사청문준비단 사무실로 첫 출근을 하며 공소 취소를 지휘할 것인지 묻는 질문에 “기존 입장에 변화는 없다”면서도 이같이 답했다. 이틀 전 이 후보자는 공소 취소 여부에 대해 “진상 규명에 집중하는 게 맞다”며 “나머지 일은 법과 원칙에 따라 하는 것이 바람직하다”고 첫 공식 입장을 밝혔다. 이를 놓고 야당에서 “공소 취소를 위한 수순”이라는 비판이 쏟아지자 이 후보자는 이날 “앞으로 특검의 진상 규명 활동에 대해 어떠한 예단과 선입견 없이 지켜보겠다”며 수위 조절에 나섰다.● 메모지에...

items.title: 조정식, 조작기소 특검법 논란에 “법적문제 없다”
items.snippet: 조정식 국회의장(사진)이 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과한 조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특검법’(조작기소 특검법) 위헌 논란에 대해 11일 “법적으로는 문제가 없다”고 정면으로 반박했다. 법안 통과 이후에도 야권을 중심으로 제기되는 ‘이재명 대통령 공소취소용 특검’이란 논란에 선을 긋고 나선 것. 조 의장은 이날 서울 중구 한국프레스센터에서 열린 관훈토론회에서 “9월 검찰개혁법을 처리하면서 그와 관계된 형사소송법을 여야가 같이 처리했는데, 부칙에 보면 파견 검사에 대해 수사권이 부여될 수 있다고 돼 있다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 자신과 관련된 사건을 수사하는 특검을 임명하는 것은 이해충돌이라는 비판에 대해서도 “대통령 본인의 권한으로 보면 대법관이나 대법원장, 헌법재판소 소장 등 국가의 중요한 임명권을 법적으로 갖고 있지 않느냐”...

items.title: 정부 이어 여야도 코인 과세 2년 유예 잠정 합의
items.snippet: 여야가 11일 가상자산 소득과세 유예에 잠정적으로 합의했다. 이에 따라 내년 1월 시행 예정이던 가상자산 소득 과세는 2029년까지 2년간 유예된다. 국회 재정경제기획위원회 여당 간사인 더불어민주당 오기형 의원은 이날 국회에서 조세소위를 마친 뒤 기자들과 만나 “가상자산 (과세) 연기에 대한 공감대가 있었다”며 “정부에서는 (과세를) 2년 미루겠다고 했고 여야 간에도 별다른 이견이 없었다”고 전했다. 야당 간사인 국민의힘 배준영 의원도 “가상자산 과세는 벌써 세 차례 미뤘고, 2029년까지 미루면 네 차례가 된다”며 “정부가 연기해야 된다고 해서 결국 오늘 연기가 됐다”고 했다. 이어 “(과세를) 연기하는 만큼 앞으로 정부에서 책임 있게 준비해야 한다”며 “국회 차원에서도 준비가 어떻게 되고 있는지 면밀히 살피고 같이 지도해나갈 것”이라고 밝...

items.title: 靑 일축에도… 與 수도권의원 모임 토론회선 “비거주 규제 완화”
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 수도권 의원 20명이 소속된 ‘전월세 주거 안정화를 위한 부동산 실용주의 의원 모임(전실모)’ 첫 토론회에서 “노년층의 비거주에 대해 규제 예외 확대가 필요하다”는 주장이 나왔다. 1주택자 종합부동산세(종부세) 기본공제 통일 요구에 이어 비거주 규제 완화 필요성을 공식 제기한 것. 청와대가 거주용 주택에 대한 우대 원칙을 변경하는 건 불가하다는 입장을 고수하고 당 원내지도부도 개별 의견 표명 자제를 요청했음에도 수도권 의원들을 중심으로 부동산 세제 완화 요구가 확대되고 있는 것이다.● 종부세 기본공제 통일 이어 “비거주 규제 예외 확대” 요구 11일 국회 의원회관에서 열린 전실모의 첫 토론회에선 ‘전월세 가격 안정화를 위한 비거주 1주택 규제 재검토’를 주제로 부동산 세제 완화를 요구하는 목소리가 나왔다. 이언주 의원은 모두발언에...

items.title: 李, 與 투톱과 만찬 “당정 한뜻으로 움직여야”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 11일 더불어민주당 투톱인 김민석 대표와 한병도 원내대표를 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 가졌다. 이 대통령은 이날 만찬에서 “우리 국민의 삶이 나아질 수 있도록 당정이 한마음 한뜻으로 움직여야 한다”며 내년도 예산안에 대한 여당과 국회의 적극적인 협조를 주문했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 서면 브리핑에서 전했다. 김 대표가 “양극화 극복과 소비 진작을 위해 정부의 과감하고 신속한 대책이 필요하다”고 요청하자 당정이 민생 의제에 집중하자는 당부를 한 것으로 풀이된다. 이날 만찬은 오후 6시 반부터 9시 20분까지 약 3시간 동안 이어졌다. 민주당 일각에서 종합부동산세(종부세) 기본공제 14억 원 통일 등 부동산 세제 완화 요구가 나온 것과 관련해선 별다른 논의가 이뤄지지 않은 것으로 알려졌다. 당내 일각의 요구와 관련해 당정 협의...

items.title: 北, ‘두 국가’ 헌법 공개… ‘남쪽 대한민국과 접경’ 못 박아
items.snippet: 북한이 11일 남한과의 ‘적대적 두 국가론’과 김정은 국무위원장의 핵무력 사용 권한을 명시한 헌법 개정안을 공개했다. 올 3월 헌법 개정 이후 8개월 만이자 2024년 3월 기존 헌법을 비공개 처리한 이후 2년 8개월 만에 외부에 헌법 조문을 공개한 것이다. 북한은 이날 온라인 선전매체 ‘내나라’에 3월 22, 23일 최고인민회의에서 개정한 168개조 분량의 헌법을 전격 공개했다. 새 헌법 2조에는 북한의 영토를 ‘북쪽으로 중국과 러시아, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있는 영토와 그에 기초하여 설정된 영해와 영공’이라는 조항이 추가됐다. 또한 ‘북반부’라는 표현과 ‘자주 평화통일 민족대단결의 원칙에서 조국통일을 실현’한다는 조항도 삭제됐다. 이는 김 위원장이 2023년 12월 남북관계를 한민족이 아닌 적대적 두 국가로 규정한 것을 올 3월 개정...

items.title: 조현, 우크라 외교 만나 “성실한 합의 이행을”
items.snippet: 한국과 우크라이나 외교장관이 프랑스 파리에서 주요 7개국(G7) 외교장관회의를 계기로 대면 회담을 가졌다. 양국 장관이 직접 만난 것은 우크라이나의 북한군 포로 한국행 공개 이후 벌어진 양국 간 갈등 이후 처음이다. 11일 외교부에 따르면 조현 외교부 장관(사진)은 10일(현지 시간) 안드리 시비하 우크라이나 외교장관과 만나 국가 간 상호 존중 및 신뢰와 성실한 합의 이행을 강조하면서 현안이 원만히 해결되길 바란다고 말했다. 우크라이나가 북한군 포로의 한국행에 관한 비공개 합의를 어긴 데 대해 한국 정부가 요구해온 사과와 재발 방지 조치를 염두에 둔 발언으로 풀이된다. 시비하 장관은 양국 관계를 안정적으로 관리하고 발전시키기 위한 외교적 노력을 지속해 나가자고 밝혔지만 사과 요구나 재발 방지 대책에 대해선 언급하지 않았다. 다만 시비하 장관은...

items.snippet: 지난 7월 강원 춘천시에서 A(43)씨가 아버지에게 주먹을 휘둘렀다. 부모와 함께 살던 A씨는 “술 좀 그만 마시고 취업하라”고 타이르는 아버지 얼굴을 때렸다. A씨는 신고를 받고 출동한 경찰관도 머리로 들이받았다. A씨는 1심에서 존속 폭행 및 공무집행방해 등 혐의로 징역 1년 6개월에 집행유예 4년을 선고받았다.

items.snippet: 출근길 경기 성남에서 시내버스가 차량 32대를 연쇄 추돌하는 사고가 발생했다. 이 사고로 버스에 타고 있던 승객 등 70명이 다쳤다. 10명은 중상이다. 사고는 11일 오전 7시 34분쯤 분당구 판교로 벌말사거리 근처에서 발생했다. 60대 A씨가 몰던 340번 시내버스가 신호 대기 중이던 차량 등을 잇따라 들이받았다.

items.title: “전등·히터 끄는게 버릇” 티끌 모아 80억 기부
items.snippet: 지난 9일 찾은 경남 창원의 자동차 부품 업체 경한코리아 사옥 1층 로비는 한낮인데도 어두컴컴했다. 흐린 날씨에 로비 전등이 모두 꺼져 있었기 때문이다. 사옥 3층에 있는 이상연(77) 회장 집무실로 들어서자 냉기가 감돌았다. 히터를 틀지 않았다. 이 회장은 “전기료 아끼는 게 버릇이 됐다”고 했다. 경한코리아는 40년 넘게 형편이 어려운 아이들과 노인 등에게 80여억원을 기부했다.

items.title: 해외서 산 마운자로 국내 반입 가능
items.snippet: 12일부터 해외에서 정식 처방을 받아 구매한 비만 치료제 등 의약품을 최대 3개월분까지 국내에 갖고 들어올 수 있게 됐다. 식품의약품안전처(식약처)와 관세청은 12일부터 그동안 반입이 제한됐던 비만 치료제 등의 개인 휴대 반입을 허용한다고 11일 밝혔다. 그간 식약처는 유통·보관 과정을 확인하기 어렵고, 회수·보상 등 법적 보호에도 한계가 있다는 이유 등으로 개인이 해외에서 구매한 마운자로·위고비를 ‘유해 의약품’으로 분류해 반입을 제한해왔다. 관세청에 따르면 올해 1~8월 여행자 휴대품을 통한 마운자로·위고비 불법 반입 적발 건수는 1097건으로, 지난해 연간 134건의 약 8배였다. 해외 의료기관에서 정식 처방된 개인 치료용 의약품까지 반입을 막는 건 과도한 규제라는 지적도 제기됐다.

items.title: GTX-A 삼성역 이어 남산케이블카, 또다시 충돌하는 국토부와 서울시
items.snippet: 서울시와 국토교통부가 또다시 충돌했습니다. 이번엔 ‘남산 케이블카’ 문제 때문입니다. 오세훈 서울시장이 국토부가 관련 규정 개정을 미루며 케이블카의 60년 독점 운영을 방치하고 있다고 비판하자, 국토부가 10일 밤 11시 30분 반박 자료를 내며 맞선 것입니다. 오 시장은 10일 페이스북에 “남산 케이블카는 한 사업자(한국삭도공업)가 60년 넘게 사업을 독점하고 있다”며 “독점을 대신할 수단이 서울시가 추진 중인 남산 곤돌라인데, 이를 위해선 국토부가 시행령을 개정해야 한다”고 적었습니다. 남산 곤돌라가 들어설 곳은 ‘도시자연공원’ 구역입니다. 여기엔 높이 12m를 넘는 시설물을 지을 수 없는데, 곤돌라 운행을 위해선 30m가 넘는 철탑이 필요합니다. 오 시장은 공익 시설에 한해 높이 제한 예외를 인정해 달라는 겁니다. 그는 “국토부가 케이블...

items.title: 엠케이피 "내년 매출 최대 800억"…美대형 장비사와 양산 공급 논의
items.snippet: 엠케이피가 반도체 장비용 질량유량제어기(MFC:Mass Flow Controller) 주문 급증에 힘입어 올해 매출이 작년 대비 두 배 늘어날 것이라고 전망했다. 미국 장비 업체 A사와도 대규모 양산 공급을 논의하고 있다. 이 건이 성사되면 내년 매출도 큰 폭의 확대가 이뤄질 것으로 보인다. 전석환 엠케이피 대표는 11일 "올해 연간 매출은 400억원, 이익률은 20% 수준으로 예상한다"고 밝혔다. 엠케이피는 지난해 매출 201억원, 영업손실 1억7900만원을 기록했다. 전 대표 예상대로 올해 매출이 나온다면 전년 대비 매출은 두

items.title: 스텐트? 수술?… 관상동맥 핵심 부위 치료 30년 논쟁 종지부
items.snippet: 심장에 혈액을 공급하는 관상동맥에 협착이 있으면 심근경색이 발생하는데, 이 경우 흔히 스텐트 시술로 좁아진 관상동맥을 넓힌다. 전신마취를 하지 않고, 손목 동맥을 통해 가느다란 카테터를 관상동맥에 끼워서 금속 그물망 스텐트를 삽입해 넓힌다. 그런데 심장내과 의사들이 오랫동안 스텐트 넣는 것을 꺼렸던 곳이 있다. 심장의 왼쪽 관상동맥이 시작되는 좌주간부(Left Main Coronary Artery)다. 이곳은 심장 전체 혈류의 75% 이상을 공급하는, 두 개의 주요 관상동맥이 갈라져 나오는 관문이다. 고속도로에 비유하면 여러 주요 도로로 갈라지기 전의 핵심 진입로다. 좌주간부가 막히면 심장 근육 광범위한 영역이 혈액 공급을 잃어 생명이 위험해진다.

items.title: 팔팔할지 골골댈지… 70대 건강, 50대부터 관리해야
items.snippet: 고등학교 졸업 40주년을 맞아 60세에 열린 동창회. 오랜만에 만난 친구들은 머리가 희끗해지고 배가 조금 나온 것 말고는 대체로 비슷하다. 누구는 고혈압약을 먹고, 누구는 당뇨병이 생겼다며 서로 건강 이야기를 나눈다. 그래도 대부분 걸음걸이가 활기찼고, 2차 모임까지 가서 술잔을 기울인다.

items.title: “오늘 주사 맞을 거야? 안 맞을 거야?” 부모가 결정할 일, 아이에게 묻지 마세요
items.snippet: “9개월 딸을 키우는 엄마입니다. 아이 양육 방법을 두고 남편과 의견 차이가 많습니다. 저는 아이에게 좋은 습관을 만들어주려면 울더라도 잡아줄 건 잡아주자고 하고, 남편은 돌도 안 된 아이한테 무슨 습관이냐며 울리는 건 정서에 안 좋다고 반대합니다. 어떻게 하는 게 좋을까요?”

items.title: [Dr.이은봉의 의학 연구 다이제스트] 인공감미료 많이 먹으면 언어 유창성 급감
items.snippet: 설탕이 대사질환 발생 위험을 높인다고 알려지면서, 요즘 설탕 대신 단맛을 내는 인공감미료 섭취가 청량음료·스낵·디저트 음식 등을 통해 늘고 있다. 인공감미료로는 사카린, 아스파탐 등과 같은 합성 감미료와 에리스리톨, 소비톨 등과 같은 탄수화물 관련 감미료가 있다. 인공감미료는 칼로리가 거의 없기 때문에 대사질환 위험성이 낮을 것이라고 기대했지만, 당뇨, 심혈관질환, 암, 우울증 및 치매 발생과 관련성이 알려지고 있다. 이런 맥락 속에서 미국 신경학회지에 인공감미료가 인지기능에 얼마나 영향을 주는지 심층적으로 연구한 논문이 발표됐다.

items.title: 심장 쇼크 환자, 병원서 멀리 살수록 위험… 1시간 넘어 도착하면 사망률 38.8% 높아
items.snippet: 병원에서 멀리 떨어져 살수록 심장성 쇼크 환자의 사망률이 높다는 연구 결과가 나왔다. 병원 도착까지 60분 이상 걸리는 지역의 병원 내 사망률은 10분 미만 지역보다 약 1.5배 높았다. 심장성 쇼크는 심장 펌프 기능이 급격히 떨어져 온몸에 혈액이 제대로 돌지 않는 질환이다. 삼성서울병원 중환자의학과 양정훈, 순환기내과 최기홍, 임상역학연구센터 강단비 교수 공동 연구팀은 2017년부터 2022년까지 국내 상급종합병원 중환자실에 새로 입원한 성인 심장성 쇼크 환자 8만263명을 분석한 결과를 국제학술지 ‘중환자의학’ 최근 호에 발표했다.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [한입 테크 사전] 누구나 목적에 맞게 바꿔 쓰는 AI… 메타는 왜 설계도를 공개했을까요?
items.snippet: 최근 메타가 내놓은 에이전트 앱 ‘뮤즈’를 소개한 적이 있었죠. 뮤즈의 두뇌로는 메타가 직접 만든 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) ‘뮤즈 스파크’가 쓰이는데, 챗GPT나 클로드에 견줄 만한 실력을 갖췄다는 평가를 받는다고 했죠. 그렇다면 메타는 언제부터 이렇게 LLM을 잘 만들게 됐을까요? 사실 메타가 LLM을 만든 역사는 결코 짧지 않습니다. 오픈AI가 챗GPT를 세상에 내놓은 게 2022년 11월인데, 석 달 뒤인 2023년 2월 메타도 LLM을 바로 내놓았거든요. 이름은 라마(LLaMA)예요. ‘메타 AI의 대규모 언어 모델(Large Language Model Meta AI)’을 줄인 말이죠. 그런데 메타는 오픈AI와 다른 길을 택했어요. 챗GPT처럼 이용자가 요구한 결과만 내놓는 식의 서비스를 제공할 뿐 아니라, LLM이 그 결과를 도출하...

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [뉴스 속의 한국사] 창덕궁 정문이지만… 종묘 피해 궁 서남쪽에 세웠죠
items.snippet: 지금 남아있는 우리나라의 궁궐 건물 가운데 가장 오래된 것으로 알려진 서울 창덕궁 돈화문(敦化門)이 대대적인 보수 공사에 들어간다는 뉴스가 나왔어요. 국가유산청 궁능유적본부는 “국가유산 보물인 돈화문을 보수하기 위해 이번 달부터 지붕 해체에 착수한다”고 밝혔죠. 돈화문 보수 공사는 29년 만이랍니다. 2028년 10월 마무리될 예정이지만 해체와 조사 과정에서 수리 범위가 늘어나면 연장될 수 있다고 해요. 오늘은 이 돈화문이 어떤 문화유산인지 함께 살펴보겠습니다.

items.title: Quantum Thermal Transistor via Nonlinear Environmental Coupling
items.abstract: Thermal amplification enables sensitive control of heat currents, providing a basis for heat management and thermal signal processing in quantum devices. For a harmonic oscillator coupled to emitter, collector, and base thermal reservoirs, we recover the absence of thermal amplification when system-reservoir interactions permit only single-quantum exchange. A controlled weak-nonlinearity expansion, supported by numerical stationary solutions, shows that two-quantum exchange at the emitter enables amplification and predicts its onset. When two-quantum exchange dominates at the emitter and collector, varying the base temperature redistributes populations between even and odd oscillator sectors. This changes the emitter and collector heat currents far more than the base current, enabling large thermal amplification. items.title: Analysis and Demonstration of a Current-Stiff, Isolated Capacitive Bridge Transformer
items.abstract: The traditional Voltage Source Inverter (VSI) based Dual Active Bridge (DAB) utilizes a transformer at its center to provide galvanic isolation and a turns ratio for step up/down functionality. However, the transformer is often the limiting factor of the DAB, especially as semiconductor switching speeds improve, given steel core losses, winding losses, etc. This paper presents a new DAB architecture based on Current Source Inverters (CSIs) coupled through, and isolated by, an AC capacitive bridge, yielding a system called a Capacitive Bridge Transformer (CBT). The CBT architecture eliminates all magnetic components in the AC portion of the isolated DAB circuit, reducing frequency scaling barriers normally present in DABs. The paper introduces the CBT from the perspective of duality and then develops the DC-DC power flow equations, the internal apparent power equations, and effective turn...

items.title: Electrical Stark Tuning and In Situ Field Sensing of $V_{2}$ Silicon Vacancies in a 4H-SiC a-Plane Lateral pin-Diode
items.abstract: Silicon carbide has emerged as a highly promising platform for scalable quantum technologies, with the silicon vacancy serving as a robust spin qubit and quantum sensor. However, conventional c-plane 4H-SiC restricts the experimental scheme and resonant optical excitation to the sample's geometry. The usage of a-plane substrates enables more versatile resonant optical access to the color center through the wafer surface. Here, we demonstrate the electrical control and optical addressability of $V_{2}$ (cubic lattice site) silicon vacancies within the intrinsic region of lateral pin-diodes fabricated on a-plane 4H-SiC wafers using a scalable complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) process. Despite extensive semiconductor processing, the integrated color centers exhibit good optical quality, evidenced by narrow optical transition linewidths below 80 MHz at zero bias. These embedded...

items.title: Nanostructuring Semiconductor Surfaces Using Self-Assembled Metal Nanoparticles for Optoelectronic Applications
items.abstract: Semiconductor nanostructures are key light-management elements because their geometry can strengthen light-matter interaction, suppress reflection, and enhance optical coupling. Yet their adoption across material platforms is constrained by lithography, multistep pattern transfer, persistent masks, and material-specific etching. Here, we introduce a lithography-free two-step strategy in which thermally evaporated self-assembled Ga nanoparticles act as self-consuming masks during Ar inductively coupled plasma reactive-ion etching. Correlated transmission electron microscopy on GaAs reveals the formation mechanism. Comparable erosion of the Ga nanoparticles and exposed substrate progressively converts Ga-capped pedestals into pure semiconductor nanocones while preserving crystalline order. items.title: From Growth to Devices: Oxygen-Controlled Superconductivity in BSCCO Thin Films
items.abstract: Realizing device-compatible high-$T_c$ superconductors requires simultaneous control of oxygen stoichiometry and tolerance to nanofabrication. Here, we investigate sputtered Bi$_2$Sr$_2$Ca$_{n-1}$Cu$_n$O$_{2n+4+δ}$ (BSCCO) thin films and establish a direct link between annealing conditions, oxygen incorporation, and superconducting transport. By independently varying the annealing temperature and duration, we identify an optimal annealing condition of $860\,^{\circ}$C for 3\,h, which yields the highest superconducting transition temperature and the narrowest transition among the investigated samples. X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, and X-ray photoemission spectroscopy reveal a non-monotonic evolution of lattice oxygen, which governs hole doping in the CuO$_2$ planes and produces the characteristic dome-like dependence of $T_c$ on doping concentration. We further translate these o...

items.title: SLIC: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning Small LMs for Multi-Turn Analog Circuit Optimization
items.abstract: Analog integrated circuit (IC) design is a multi-turn, simulator-grounded engineering task that demands iterative reasoning over coupled performance tradeoffs, yet proprietary process design kits (PDKs) make hosted large language model workflows difficult to deploy in practical design settings. We present SLIC (Small LM Iterating on Circuits), a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that trains a 4B-scale, locally deployable language model for closed-loop analog circuit optimization. SLIC pairs structured circuit representations with discretized relative-update actions, domain- and success-gated multiobjective rewards, and Reward-Guided Rollout Steering (RGRS), which turns per-step simulator feedback into signals for both policy learning and online rollout construction in this sparse, highly constrained domain. items.title: 5G CATS: 5G-Based Cryptographic Authorization Against Trafficking of Semiconductor Devices
items.abstract: Enforcing export controls on AI accelerators requires verifying where a chip operates after deployment. Round-trip time measurements can bound a chip's distance from a trusted landmark, but any jitter in honest replies forces the verifier to loosen its timeout, giving an attacker slack to relay traffic over fiber from a restricted region. Prior approaches either cross the untrusted host stack or rely on noisy power-line channels that inflate this slack. We present 5G CATS, a location certification system that pairs a co-packaged 5G radio, cryptographic engine, and hardware interlock on the GPU package with 5G Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) base stations. Terminating the radio link inside the package removes the host software, PCIe fabric, and baseboard management controller from the verification path. items.title: Ultrafast Hole Transport and Electron Localization in Superatomic Re$_{6}$Se$_{8}$Cl$_{2}$
items.abstract: Van der Waals superatomic crystals represent an intriguing class of materials, exhibiting unique ultrafast electronic and structural responses arising from their hierarchical crystal structure. These materials bridge the properties of semiconductors, molecular solids, and nanocrystal arrays, hosting a range of many-body interactions that can be controlled with atomically precise structures. To establish the structure-function correlation, it is necessary to understand element-specific electronic states arising from complex superatomic unit cells. Here, we use transient XUV spectroscopy to individually probe the dynamics of photoexcited electrons and holes in Re$_{6}$Se$_{8}$Cl$_{2}$ superatomic crystals. items.title: The Weight Is in the Reading: Hidden States in Memristors, Memlumors, and Electrochemical Transistors
items.abstract: Physical synapses are routinely described by a single number, the weight, that is identified with a conductance, a current, or a luminescence yield. This identification conflates two different objects: the internal state that the device stores, and the signal obtained when that state is read. Building on Chua's formulation of memristive systems, we separate the state variable, which evolves with the excitation history, from the observation map that converts it into a measured signal, and we define the weight as the outcome of a specified read protocol. Three platforms show the consequences: a memristor, in which the same voltage writes and reads; a memlumor, in which light both modifies the state and produces the photoluminescence that reports it; and an organic electrochemical transistor (OECT), in which the gate writes and the channel reads. items.title: Ground-state phase diagram of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg zigzag ladder with anisotropic $Γ$ term revisited
items.abstract: We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet with an anisotropic $Γ$ term on a zigzag ladder, which can be exactly mapped to the spin-1/2 XYZ zigzag ladder by a spin rotation. This model has recently attracted considerable interest as an effective model for the quasi-one-dimensional magnetic semiconductor YbCuS$_2$. For the model, the ground-state phase diagram was previously proposed by Saito and Hotta [Phys. Rev. Lett. 132, 166701 (2024); Phys. Rev. B 110, 024409 (2024)]. We systematically reexamine the phase diagram through complementary numerical and analytical approaches, including exact diagonalization, the density-matrix renormalization group method, and low-energy effective theories. items.title: Neutronic Field-Effect Transistor
items.abstract: Field-effect electronic devices are in widespread use in communication, computing, data storage, and sensing applications. We demonstrate a neutronic field-effect transistor (NFET) that is analogous to the Datta-Das electron spin transistor and atomtronic devices. The NFET is based on a perfect-crystal Mach-Zehnder neutron interferometer with phase shifts applied to the spin and path degrees of freedom.

items.title: Spin-valve effect through electrostatic coupling
items.abstract: We propose a spin-valve effect in which an insulating magnetic van der Waals multilayer controls the conductance of an adjacent non-magnetic conductor by electrostatic coupling, without transport-electrons entering the magnetic layers. The coupling is induced by the variations of the electronic structure when the relative orientation of the magnetization of adjacent monolayers changes from parallel to antiparallel, modifying both the dielectric constant and band alignment. We consider two types of coupling and device concepts: charge transfer to a graphene monolayer and capacitive coupling in a single-electron transistor. We use density functional calculations to assess the magnitude of the effect in various materials, including CrI$_3$, CrBr$_3$, CrCl$_3$ and NiBr$_2$. items.title: Gate-tunable supercurrent switching in a three-terminal quantum dot transistor
items.abstract: We propose and analyze a three-terminal superconducting transistor switch in which a gate-defined quantum dot region interrupts a flux-controlled loop. The output supercurrent is switched off completely when the two loop arms couple to the dot with equal tunneling strengths and half a flux quantum threads the loop. The device then operates as a symmetric SQUID at half flux. The condition follows from a single geometric factor $χ$, which reduces the three-terminal problem to an equivalent two-terminal Anderson impurity model and makes the switching mechanism independent of the Coulomb interaction, the dot level position, the total hybridization and temperature. These enter only through a prefactor and thus decide how tolerant the device is to imperfect barrier tuning. items.abstract: Many currently envisaged scalable architectures for Si/SiGe spin qubit devices utilize gate-controlled multi-dot configurations characterized by their peculiar Coulomb blockade physics. One example is the concurrent use of a single electron transistor (SET) as a charge sensor and as a reservoir for adjacent qubit quantum dots (QD). We find that the SET energy spectrum impacts pulsed gate spectroscopy of the QD when the SET simultaneously acts as the reservoir and the sensor. Then, using the qubit QD as a probe, we quantify how strongly the electron temperature of the SET depends on the applied bias. It surpasses a reference experiment by 100 $mK$ even at 50 $μV$ bias. items.abstract: Three-phase ac-ac converters for variable-speed drives can be realized conventionally as voltage-source converters (VSCs) or, leveraging emerging monolithic bidirectional GaN power transistors (M-BDSs), as current-source converters (CSCs). This paper presents a comparative life-cycle assessment of a realized VSC and a CSC demonstrators including grid-side and motor-side EMI filters, and with identical specifications (1.4 kW rated power, 200 V line-to-line rms grid and motor voltage). The embodied carbon footprints are similar (44.8 kgCO2eq for the VSC and 47.4 kgCO2eq for the CSC) and dominated by auxiliary and control electronics, and the printed circuit boards. items.title: Rapid Heat Removal from Chip Cores: Near-Junction Active Cooling of Power Transistors via Electron Entropy Transport and Spatial Decoupling
items.abstract: Chip performance is limited by a shared bottleneck: the core produces heat faster than it can be moved out. We study the hardest case, RF power GaN HEMTs, whose hotspots exceed 5 kW/cm^2, and propose a horizontal near-junction active cooling topology built on electron entropy transport. Classical on-chip thermoelectric cooling faces a contest: Peltier absorption grows linearly with current, Joule heating with its square. In a vertical pillar, its own conduction resistance locks about half the Joule heat back toward the cold end, capping net cooling. From the Onsager framework we show the origin of this asymmetry: Peltier absorption localizes at the interface where the Seebeck coefficient jumps, whereas Joule heating fills the volume. items.title: Orbital texture of valence band and interband transitions of the type-II multiferroic van der Waals NiI$_2$
items.abstract: NiI$_2$ is a van der Waals semiconductor characterized by complex electronic and magnetic phases, holding promise towards functional applications. For this purpose, a detailed understanding of its band structure and its excitations is essential to elucidate the electronic and transport properties. We present a comprehensive description of the band structure and of the lowest valence-to-conduction band transition in bulk NiI$_2$, by means of time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations. We describe the orbital character of Ni and I manifolds, and identify the main momentum-resolved features of the valence band and the shallow minima of the conduction band. items.title: A Per-Step Load-Balancing Engine for Expert-Parallel MoE Serving
items.abstract: In expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts serving, a layer finishes only when the most loaded GPU of its group does. Token routing shifts at every decode step and concentrates on a few experts, so most of the group's reserved GPU time waits on stragglers. Recovering that time means re-deciding, at every layer of every decode step, how each replicated expert's tokens divide between its copies. The exact linear-program solvers that make this decision optimally take longer than many of the layers they serve, and their working set outgrows GPU shared memory at deployment scale. We introduce Relief, a bidirectional pairwise relaxation that makes the linear program unnecessary, coming within a fraction of a point of the per-step optimum in a few passes of integer halving over the token counts. items.title: ICLayout-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Custom Circuit Layout Design
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are being explored for circuit design, but their ability to produce high-quality custom layouts has not been extensively evaluated. ICLayout-Bench is a benchmark in which agents use electronic design automation (EDA) tools to construct and optimize GDSII layouts from transistor-level circuit netlists. These layouts are evaluated using physical verification, parasitic extraction, and post-layout simulation. Layouts that pass the physical and functional checks are scored on electrical performance and area. The benchmark includes 165 tasks across 13 process design kits (PDKs), covering technology nodes from 3 nm to 180 nm. The tasks span analog, mixed-signal, and digital circuits in open-source and commercial EDA flows. The experiments evaluate 22 configurations spanning seven models on 21 public and 19 private tasks. items.title: $>3\text{ W/mm}$ Output Power $\mathrm{Al}_{0.61}\mathrm{Ga}_{0.39}\mathrm{N}$ Channel HEMT with $24.4\%$ Associated PAE at $10\text{ GHz}$
items.abstract: In this work, an ultra-wide bandgap (UWBG) high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) was fabricated using an $\mathrm{Al}_{0.76}\mathrm{Ga}_{0.24}\mathrm{N}$ barrier and an $\mathrm{Al}_{0.61}\mathrm{Ga}_{0.39}\mathrm{N}$ channel with thick $\mathrm{SiO}_2$ passivation. The device demonstrated low current collapse at $40\text{ V}$ drain bias. At $10\text{ GHz}$, the device exhibited an output power of $3.07\text{ W/mm}$ with an associated power-added efficiency (PAE) of $24.4\%$. A peak PAE of $33.9\%$ was achieved at an associated output power of $2.14\text{ W/mm}$. This excellent large-signal performance highlights the strong potential of UWBG $\mathrm{AlGaN}$ channel devices for X-band applications.

items.title: Demonstration of High fmax (> 80 GHz) in Recessed-Gate and Passivated $\mathrm{Al_{0.60}Ga_{0.40}N}$ Channel RF HEMTs
items.abstract: In this work, ultra-wide bandgap (UWBG) $\mathrm{Al_{0.60}Ga_{0.40}N}$ channel high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs) with an $\mathrm{Al_{0.81}Ga_{0.19}N}$ barrier and an $\mathrm{Al_{0.86}Ga_{0.14}N}$ back barrier were fabricated. The devices featured a recessed T-gate structure and $\mathrm{SiO_2}$ passivation. Scaled devices achieved a cutoff frequency ($f_{\mathrm{T}}$) of 35 GHz, a maximum oscillation frequency ($f_{\mathrm{max}}$) of 82 GHz, and an average breakdown field $> 3 \mathrm{MV/cm}$, while maintaining a reasonable current collapse of $\sim 20\%$ under a 40 V drain bias in pinch-off condition. Devices with larger dimensions demonstrated a high off-state breakdown voltage of 883 V and an $f_{\mathrm{T}}$ of 24 GHz, yielding a high Johnson's figure of merit ($\mathrm{JFOM}$) of 21.19 $\mathrm{THz \cdot V}$. items.title: Deterministically fabricated C-band single-photon sources based on quantum dot circular Bragg grating cavities
items.abstract: Telecom-wavelength quantum light sources are essential components for scalable fiber-based quantum networks, where on-demand emission of single photons is required for high secret key rates. Here, we demonstrate the deterministic integration of metal-organic vapor-phase epitaxy (MOVPE)-grown C-band InAs/InP quantum dots into circular Bragg grating resonators. The integrated emitters exhibit a radiative lifetime of $T_1 = (1400 \pm 50)~\mathrm{ps}$ and a spectral linewidth of $ΔE_{\mathrm{FWHM}} = (41.0 \pm 4.0)~μ\mathrm{eV}$. Under non-resonant excitation, we measure a post-selected single-photon purity of $(0.95 \pm 0.02)$ and a raw two-photon interference visibility of $V_{12\mathrm{ns}} = (35 \pm 2)\%$, which increases to $(70 \pm 18)\%$ under temporal post-selection. items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) with low-power operation and non-volatile data retention enabled by stable ferroelectric polarization switching, have emerged as promising alternatives to conventional floating-gate transistors for next-generation low-power memory applications. A FeFET with two-dimensional (2D) channel provides the opportunity for better electrostatic gate control and scalability beyond silicon. In this work, we report wafer scale 2D semiconductor-based FeFETs with Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) gate stack showing unusual p-type charge transport and stable multibit memory properties. FeFETs based on 2-3 monolayer Molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) channel and a 20 nm HZO back gate oxide layer exhibit a large hysteresis with a memory window spanning 4.4 V under a operating voltage range of +3.8 to -3.8 V, and an ION/IOFF ratio of 10^5. items.abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (2D-TMDs) offer a promising platform for realizing dilute magnetic semiconductors. However, simultaneously achieving large magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) and high Curie temperature (T$_\text{c}$) remains a major challenge. In this work, we employ DFT+U to systematically investigate the thermodynamic stability and magnetic properties of 2D-MoSe$_2$ and 2D-WSe$_2$ doped with transition metal atoms. We found that the paired dopant configurations are more stable than previously attributed isolated dopants. Despite their nearly identical crystal structures, 2D-MoSe$_2$ and 2D-WSe$_2$ show contrasting properties upon doping. items.title: Fabrication and Characterization of Flexible In2O3 Thin-Film Transistors on Mica Substrates
items.abstract: Flexible oxide-semiconductor thin-film transistors (TFTs) with high field-effect mobility (uFE > 70 cm^2/Vs) are required for next-generation flexible displays. Polycrystalline In2O3-based TFTs are promising candidates; however, conventional flexible substrates such as plastics are not suitable because their fabrication typically requires relatively high temperatures (~350 deg.C). In this study, we used mica as a flexible substrate to fabricate polycrystalline In2O3-based TFTs, motivated by previous demonstrations of crystalline oxide growth on mica. The resulting TFTs exhibited a uFE of approximately 75 cm^2/Vs. The devices maintained gate-modulated operation after 10^3 flex-out bending cycles at a 5 mm radius, whereas flex-in cycling caused early electrical failure, likely due to In2O3 film degradation. items.title: The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics
items.abstract: Embedded AI is moving from perception to prediction. Robots now use world models$\unicode{x2014}$learned simulators that predict the outcome of candidate actions in a compressed latent space before any is executed. Every predicted step must be computed on board within a tight power and thermal budget, yet the energy these steps fundamentally require, and how far real hardware sits from it, have not been characterized. We derive lower bounds on the arithmetic operations and the CMOS dynamic energy of a latent state transition from information theory and Boolean circuit complexity. Profiling a DreamerV3-style Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) shows that every rollout operation is memory-bandwidth bound and that a GPU consumes at least $5.9\times10^{10}$ times the CMOS energy floor. items.title: How light interacts with matter, revisited
items.abstract: In 1968 Victor Weisskopf explained in Scientific American how light interacts with matter, with a few formulas and many words. We tell the same story again with the tools that have since become available: the fields are computed and drawn, and their evolution in time is shown in animations. Light is described as a classical electromagnetic field and matter as a collection of charged oscillators; every phenomenon follows from adding up the retarded waves radiated by the oscillators, each with its proper delay and phase. From this single picture we obtain the blue of the sky and the white of the clouds, transparency and the refractive index, the Ewald-Oseen extinction theorem, reflection and the colours of thin films, why metals reflect and what gives metals and semiconductors their colours, polarizers, Brewster's angle and birefringence, the working of mirrors, lenses, microscopes and the...

items.title: Controlled Oxidation of Tellurium Nanoparticles for Telecom Detection
items.abstract: Surface oxidation plays an important role in governing charge transport in semiconductor nanoparticle assemblies. Here, we investigate the optoelectronic properties of solution-processed tellurium (Te) nanoparticle ensembles prepared through gradual ambient-air exposure. Structural and spectroscopic analyses reveal interconnected elemental Te nanoparticles with coexisting alpha-TeO2 and hydroxyl-containing surface species, exhibiting a lower relative contribution of oxidized Te than previously investigated forced-air-oxidized ensembles. The resulting photodetectors demonstrate photoresponse at 405, 532, and 1550 nm, with maximum responsivities of 10.1, 14.4, and 8.5 mA/W, respectively. At 1550 nm, the device exhibits rise and fall times of 17.7 and 40.2 s, respectively, and an estimated shot-noise-limited specific detectivity of 1.3 * 10^6 Jones. items.title: Trajectory-Dependent Decoherence and Leakage During Shuttling of Multi-Spin Qubits
items.abstract: Logical qubits encoded in collective states of multiple spins are promising building blocks for large-scale semiconductor quantum processors. As novel fault-tolerant architectures increasingly rely on qubit shuttling, understanding decoherence of the shuttled multi-spin qubits becomes crucial. We analyze fidelity and leakage of the logical qubits dephased by the spatio-temporally correlated $1/f$ noise, considering two-, three-, and four-spin encodings. We study different shuttling protocols and establish that for all encodings generally, parallel shuttling provides the best protection against decoherence at short distances, whereas sequential shuttling outperforms others for long-range transport (although the exact boundaries depend on the specific device parameters). We explain this common behavior in terms of the dephasing factors of pairs of the shuttled spins; we provide explicit ex...

items.title: Discrete time crystals and heteroclinic switching in actively mode-locked semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We investigate the mechanisms underlying the emergence of discrete time crystals in actively mode-locked semiconductor lasers. Our analysis is based on a Haus master equation generalized to retain carrier memory between round-trips. We perform a detailed bifurcation analysis that reveals a well-defined hierarchy of subharmonic states, illustrating how pulses may suppress their neighbors when the modulation runs faster than the pulse round-trip frequency. To identify the underlying mechanism, we derive effective equations of motion that couple the pulse energies, their positions relative to the modulation transmission maxima, and the local time-dependent gain. These reveal that transitions between time-crystalline states occur via transcritical global bifurcations, opening a regime of heteroclinic winnerless competition between symmetry-degenerate configurations.

items.title: Microscopic theory of exciton polarons in transition metal dichalcogenides
items.abstract: Polarons are composite quasiparticles formed when charge carriers strongly couple to lattice vibrations, manifesting as carriers dressed by a surrounding cloud of phonons. Although this dressing fundamentally renormalizes the effective mass and mobility of carriers, its impact on electrically neutral exciton polarons in 2D semiconductors has received limited attention. In particular, despite the growing interest in polaronic effects in atomically thin semiconductors, only a few theoretical studies have addressed spectral signatures and renormalized properties of exciton polarons in these materials. Here, we develop a microscopic model to describe exciton polarons in transition metal dichalcogenides. items.title: Exciton design via topological spin textures
items.abstract: Excitons carry energy and information through a semiconductor without carrying charge. This makes them attractive for optoelectronics, but also hard to guide. Magnetic skyrmions, on the other hand, are moved by small electrical currents. Here we develop a theory of excitons interacting with a skyrmion in which the electron and the hole are treated as distinct constituents, each with its own spin--orbit coupling. We find that the topology of the skyrmion is transferred to the exciton only when the exchange coupling exceeds the relevant spin--orbit splitting. The exciton then experiences a full flux quantum, with opposite signs in the two valleys. The quantum metric of the spin texture creates a ring-shaped barrier that traps excitons, whereas the topological charge fixes the angular momentum of the trapped states and hence their optical selection rules. items.title: Advances in High-Precision Astrometry for Exoplanet Detection for Astrometric Missions
items.abstract: High-precision astrometry is a cornerstone for detecting Earth-like exoplanets in the habitable zones of nearby solar-type stars and probing the nature of dark matter in galactic environments. Achieving sub-microarcsecond accuracy requires unprecedented control over detector morphology, optical distortion, and astrometric measurement techniques. This paper reviews recent progress in characterizing large format detector at the micropixel scale level, calibrating optical distortion using reference stars, and refining differential astrometry methods to detect the faint astrometric signatures of Earth-mass exoplanets. We highlight the latest developments in the RETINA project, which aims to advance the TRL of GIGAPYX 220 MP CMOS detectors from Pyxalis which are critical components for future space missions such as ESA's Theia and NASA's Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO). items.title: On the collective flow puzzle in ultra-central heavy-ion collisions
items.abstract: Using UCC-DiffHIC, an AI-accelerated event-by-event hydrodynamic model validated against hybrid simula- tions, we study flow in ultracentral Pb-Pb collisions. For suitable initial conditions, the calculated v2{2}/v3{2} approaches unity in the most central collisions, consistent with experiment. An exact response decomposition shows that residual fluctuations suppress the ratio through P3/P2 < 1, where P2 and P3 are Pearson response correlations for elliptic and triangular flow, respectively. This resolves the apparent flow hierarchy without requiring a breakdown of linear response or additional effects such as nuclear deformation.

items.title: Inverse design of superconductors and semiconductors with differentiable foundation models
items.abstract: Designing a crystal for a target property requires choosing its elements, stoichiometry, and atomic structure together, yet gradients exist only for the continuous structural variables. items.abstract: Kinetic equations in the high-field regime describe particle transport dominated by electric-field acceleration and collisional relaxation. Their high dimensionality and multiscale nature pose two of the major challenges to accurate and efficient numerical solution. To address these challenges, we propose an asymptotic-preserving tensor neural network (APTNN) method. Specifically, to reduce high-dimensional computational costs and memory requirements, we adopt the canonical polyadic (CP) decomposition structure of TNNs to approximate their solutions. We show that the equation residuals retain this decomposition form, allowing high-dimensional loss integrals to be evaluated through combinations of one-dimensi...

We develop a topology-resolved Lindblad framework for driven three-level excitonic manifolds at fixed center-of-mass momentum, in which a single exciton couples to phonons, the radiation field and a dilute exciton gas. The $Ξ$ and $V$ manifolds are selected from the exciton spectrum by systematically screening optical brightness, intra-excitonic dipole strength and state compactness, making the selection reproducible and transferable to other materials. items.abstract: Gate-defined semiconductor quantum dots are promising building blocks for scalable spin-based quantum processors, however their operational properties depend on several fabrication and control parameters, such as lithographic gate layout and applied voltages. Existing device architectures have been refined through repeated fabrication and experimental testing, producing layouts that support reliable device operation. However, this process does not exhaustively explore the design space, limiting the ability to obtain qubits with targeted properties. We address these challenges by presenting a differentiable inverse co-design framework for electrostatically defined quantum dots that jointly optimises gate voltages and the gate electrode layout. A semiclassical Thomas--Fermi electrostatic simulator provides reference data for a Fourier neural operator (FNO) surrogate, which predicts the two...

items.title: Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering
items.abstract: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window. We design the Micius data pipeline as a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel comprising three stages: knowledge tree construction and expansion, data synthesis, and quality validation with hard-example augmentation. From this data, we train expert models for semiconductor knowledge and reasoning, hardware coding, and semiconductor multimodal understanding, along with agentic experts. Subsequently, we employ Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) to supervise training on sequences generated by Micius itself, thereby integrating the capabilities of these expert models into a unified model. items.abstract: The origin of the apparent metal-insulator transition in two-dimensional electron systems remains debated. Using temperature-dependent transport and Hall measurements on industry-relevant MoS$_2$ monolayer FETs with amorphous HfO$_2$ dielectrics, we establish classical percolation as the underlying mechanism. We report two complementary signatures of disorder-driven conduction onset: a temperature-independent Hall-density collapse as a function of absolute gate voltage and a vanishing activation energy at a characteristic carrier density $n_{\mathrm{c}}$, identified as the percolation threshold. These findings identify dielectric-interface disorder, rather than channel quality alone, as the key parameter governing device turn-on. items.abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. In this study, we examine the photonic and electronic coupling between single ZnO nanowire lasers and TMDs. Using deterministic nanomanipulation, we first hybridized the same nanowire first with a WS$_2$ monolayer and then with a MoS$_2$ monolayer. The respective lasing threshold rises, the emission is strongly quenched at high pump power densities, and the mode envelope blueshifts. Upon hybridization with bilayer, trilayer, and bulk MoS$_2$, lasing is fully suppressed. Finite-Difference Eigenmode simulations show that the TMD absorbs part of the evanescent field. items.title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
items.abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. items.title: Electrostatics of Chern junctions in a magnetic field
items.abstract: Electrostatic control is central to the operation of semiconductor junctions made from conventional materials. Here, we theoretically investigate the electrostatic properties of lateral junctions between two-dimensional (2D) Chern semiconductors in a perpendicular magnetic field. The spectral asymmetry of a Chern semiconductor acts as a magnetic-field-induced effective dopant density that is dependent on the Chern number. As a consequence, two regions with different Chern numbers acquire different chemical potentials at charge neutrality, leading to a built-in potential of topological origin across the junction. Using this built-in potential as a boundary condition, we solve the 2D Poisson equation to obtain the electric potential and charge density profiles, as well as the capacitance, of Chern semiconductor junctions. items.title: NN-Based FeFET Compact Modeling for SPICE Simulation
items.abstract: Prototyping and early-stage circuit evaluation for emerging transistor technologies require fast and accurate compact models for SPICE simulations. Standard physics-based compact models, such as BSIM, offer high fidelity but demand extensive domain expertise and time-consuming equation formulation for every new physical effect, significantly slowing technology development. Neural network (NN)-based models offer a scalable alternative approach, but they rely heavily on smooth numerical solver data with explicit high-order derivative information. However, measurement data suffers from complex noise patterns, making derivative extraction challenging and complicating NN-based transistor modeling. This work presents a derivative-free NN training framework employing spectral normalization to naturally smooth derivative behavior and filter measurement noise. items.abstract: In this article, we prove two compactness parabolic extrapolation theorems for linear operators and their commutators on parabolic weighted Lebesgue spaces. items.title: Atomic-Scale Phonon Engineering for Enhanced Thermal Transport in Wafer-Scale-Bonded $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC Heterostructures
items.abstract: Bonding semiconductors to substrates with high thermal conductivity is a promising way to solve the heat-dissipation problem of materials that transport heat poorly, and it avoids the lattice-matching constraints of conventional epitaxy. However, the lattice mismatch remains, leaving the two materials with mismatched phonon states, while poor interface quality scatters phonons even more. Together, these effects block phonon transport across the bonded interface and make interfacial thermal resistance a critical bottleneck, calling for careful interface engineering. Here, $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC serves as a model system for a phonon-bridging strategy. A nanoscale crystalline Si interlayer is designed and fabricated by wafer bonding to bridge the mismatched phonon states of $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ and SiC. items.title: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection
items.abstract: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. items.title: Generative Modeling for Cascading Extremes via Autoregressive Transformers
items.abstract: Extreme events often occur sequentially, from earthquake-tsunami cascades to successive extreme losses in financial markets. We introduce an extremal token representation that encodes multivariate observations as a categorical sequence. A quiet token records the absence of threshold exceedances; otherwise, the token identifies the exceeding component with the largest marginal probability-scale score. The representation is invariant to componentwise strictly increasing transformations. It preserves the identity and temporal ordering of dominant exceedances but discards their magnitudes and the identities of nondominant simultaneous exceedances. A decoder-only transformer estimates the history-dependent next-token kernel on this representation, and recursive sampling generates future token sequences from the induced joint predictive law. items.abstract: First-principles defect calculations can now be performed autonomously by AI agents, enabled by established computational methods and open-source Python toolkits. However, reliable and repeatable defect calculations require clear scientific and technical guidance that helps agents resolve ambiguities and avoid errors in calculation setup, execution, postprocessing, and analysis. Here, we present DefectSkills, a set of structured prompts that provides human-in-the-loop guidance to AI agents performing first-principles calculations of point defects in semiconductors and insulators using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP). items.abstract: Polaron hopping in disordered molecular semiconductors such as eumelanin is set by energetic disorder $σ$ and reorganization energy $λ$. We show that the reduced polaron absorption band encodes this transport problem. Its value at zero energy fixes the mean hop rate, which bounds the mobility in any dimension. For Gaussian disorder and classical vibrations its centroid is $E_\mathrm{op}=λ+(1-c)σ^2/k_BT$, its variance obeys the Hush relation, and the bound is the Marcus rate at $λ\to E_\mathrm{op}$; a 1D lower bound vanishes at $k_BT^*=(1-c)σ^2/λ$, read from optics.

items.title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
items.abstract: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. items.title: A RISC-V Simulator for the Tenstorrent Tensix Architecture
items.abstract: RISC-V based AI accelerators have become popular and not only for AI and ML, but also as vehicles for exploring HPC workloads more generally. Tenstorrent are one example, and whilst they document their Tensix architecture in detail and develop their software stack openly, running code has historically required a physical card, and their recently released simulator targets hardware equivalence rather than introspection. In this paper we present Wolfpine, a community developed RISC-V simulator for the Tensix architecture, supporting both the Wormhole and Blackhole generations and integrating seamlessly with the TT-Metal software stack. Constructed entirely from publicly available documentation, open source software and measurements on physical hardware, Wolfpine is written in pure Python for readability and ease of modification. items.title: Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
items.abstract: The real mechanism of ferromagnetism in III-V diluted magnetic semiconductors such as Ga$_{1-x}$Mn$_x$As is still debated. The experimental results point out the realization of appreciable ferromagnetism at filling of the impurity band close to one-half that can be expressed in terms of compensation degree. The molecular-field-like equation is derived in which the effective exchange constant contains all necessary information about material, including the Mn content, the compensation degree, the crystal coordination, and the parameters of two competing pair exchange interactions. items.title: Gate-tunable superconductor-semiconductor coupling and its impact on zero-energy modes in PbTe-Pb nanowires
items.abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor coupling in hybrid nanowires plays a pivotal role in Majorana devices. Here, we demonstrate this tunable coupling in PbTe-Pb nanowires and its impact on the induced gap and zero-bias peaks (ZBPs). In the strong coupling regime, the device reveals a clean superconducting gap, where robust and non-robust ZBPs are observed in distinct magnetic field ranges. Conversely, increasing the gate voltage drives the system toward the weak coupling regime, where the gap becomes narrow and soft. Consequently, robust ZBPs disappear while non-robust ones persist. Our results establish a direct link between tunable coupling and robust ZBPs, providing guidelines on engineering Majorana zero modes and topological qubits.

items.title: Amplification of valley polarization in an hBN-separated MoSe2-WSe2 heterostructure
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures host long-lived interlayer excitons in the +K and -K valleys that can encode long-lived valley polarization. We investigated the low-temperature valley polarization dynamics in an MoSe2-bilayer hBN-WSe2 heterostructure. The bilayer hBN spacer results in an interlayer exciton lifetime exceeding 2 μs and an anomalous valley polarization amplification effect. Our theoretical model shows that this amplification results from the long exciton lifetime and exciton-exciton interactions. This work sets the stage for long-lived interlayer excitons to be used in nonlinear valleytronic transistors and amplifiers.

items.title: Optical Detection of Coefficient of Thermal Expansion via Frequency Tracking at Cryogenic Temperatures

In this work, we present an in-situ, non-destructive optical methodology to determine the CTE of suspended nanofilms by tracking the temperature-dependence of their vibrational frequency. This approach eliminates thickness measurements entirely and works for amorphous films where X-ray diffraction (XRD) fails. Disc-like particles in optical traps have been identified as promising candidates for detectors of high frequency gravitational waves or as sensitive accelerometers.

items.title: Residual AM and PM Noise of Selected X-Band Amplifiers
items.abstract: In microwave systems design, amplitude modulation (AM) noise is often ignored relative to phase modulation (PM) noise. However, in high-performance applications requiring ultra-low PM noise, AM noise becomes a critical limiting factor due to AM-to-PM conversion mechanisms. Because AM noise specifications are rarely, if ever, provided for commercial microwave components, this study characterizes the residual AM and PM noise of several 10 GHz amplifiers. We present performance data for various Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor (HBT) amplifier designs and demonstrate the noise reduction achieved through power-summed configurations. For example, a discrete-die GaAs HBT amplifier achieves residual PM noise below $-160$ dBrad$^2$/Hz and AM noise of approximately $-155$ dB/Hz at a 1 kHz offset in a quad power-summed configuration. items.title: Hierarchical Fourier Phase Projection for Local Electronic Observables
items.abstract: In this letter, we develop hierarchical Fourier phase projection (HPP) for the calculation of local electronic observables. The method couples the spatial decay of the density matrix with a hierarchy of Fourier probes, improving accuracy through refinement, and making use of all previously evaluated responses. The variation in the calculated observables during the refinement process carries information on the residual error. We use a locality-based model to estimate the error from these changes with no extra probing calculations. In particular, we demonstrate the method for electron densities and nonlocal pseudopotential forces for fixed Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians of semiconductors, metals and thermally perturbed silica. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for the decoherence of negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy (NV$^-$) centres in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. items.title: Uncertainty and Business-Aware Remaining Useful Life Estimation for Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.abstract: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimates guide maintenance in semiconductor manufacturing, where a late intervention can disrupt production but an early one discards usable equipment life. A single prediction does not express the uncertainty needed to choose between these outcomes. We combine Deep Learning (DL) sequence models with Simoultaneous Quantile Regression (SQR) to estimate RUL at selectable quantile levels, and evaluate maintenance decisions using Unexpected Breaks (UB), Unexploited Lifetime (UL), and a cost-weighted objective. On the $F_1$ fault mode of the 2018 PHM Data Challenge (PHM18) ion-milling dataset, we compare recurrent, Transformer, and State Space Models (SSM) architectures. Diagonal State Spaced (S4D) gives the strongest overall RUL accuracy across the evaluated quantiles. items.title: Transport-Noise and Optical Witnesses of Electronic Multipartite Entanglement
items.abstract: Entanglement among particles distinguishes correlated quantum materials from conventional metals and semiconductors. Experimentally certifying intrinsic entanglement among interacting electrons in materials is important not only for classifying states of matter, but also for developing material-based quantum technologies. We present a hybrid data- and pipeline-parallel optical broadcast delay-line memory architecture that accounts for fiber's physical realities. items.title: Bright and Dark Excitons in CrSBr: Local Ligand-Field Character and Band-Coherent Optical Selection Rules
items.abstract: Magnetic van der Waals semiconductors such as CrSBr host an intricate exciton landscape. Quasiparticle self-consistent GW theory with electron-hole ladder vertex corrections (QSGWc) has established the gap and the character of the bright XA (1.34 eV) and XB (1.8 eV) excitons. Why these bright excitons coexist, within a few tens of meV, with companions orders of magnitude darker has remained unexplained. Here we show that brightness is fixed by a symmetry of the structure: a mirror-glide exchanges the two Cr atoms of each layer, every exciton has a definite parity under it, and bright and dark partners are its even and odd members. The even sector carries the b-axis dipole; the odd sector is suppressed by about three orders of magnitude. items.title: Transmon Phase Gates Controlled by Superconducting Soliton DAC
items.abstract: We introduce a superconducting digital-to-analog converter (DAC) that filters control noise, provides native multiplexing, performs quantum gates in nanoseconds, and can be controlled by CMOS. This is achieved by transducing a trapezoidal drive pulse into a superconducting soliton, which is then held in the DAC load loop, applying flux to a mutually-coupled superconducting qubit or gate coupler. The analog flux output by the DAC can be easily controlled by varying the soliton hold time, or with a DC-biased tunable DAC-qubit coupler, allowing the DAC to perform a fixed-time, high-fidelity gate that's robust to fabrication variance or flux offsets in the quantum circuit. Our initial demonstration shows that the DAC can successfully perform 5.6 ns S-gates on transmons. items.title: Carruthers Data Processing Pipeline: Instrument Effect Correction

Its primary payload, the GeoCoronal Imager, consists of two coaligned photometric imagers that measure ultraviolet Lyman-alpha emission radiance from exospheric hydrogen simultaneously at wide- and narrow- fields of view. The imagers use MicroChannel Plate intensified Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor detectors, which are known to add various artifacts to the final image telemetered from the spacecraft, hereby known as instrument effects. items.title: Controllable Quantum Spin Hall Phases in Bi$_2$Te$_3$-Family van der Waals Heterobilayers
items.abstract: The tunability and control of topological edge/surface states are crucial for the development of new device applications. In this work, by combining first-principles calculations and Wannier-based tight-binding methods, we show the emergence of quantum spin Hall phases in van der Waals heterostructures formed by stacking two trivial quintuple layers from the Bi$_2$Te$_3$ family. We demonstrate the tunability of the edge states under interlayer strain and external electric field effects, suggesting the possibility of switching topological edge states on/off by external control. Additionally, the quantum spin Hall edge channels remain robust against interlayer twist, highlighting their stability against external perturbations. items.title: Coexistence of Donor and Acceptor Hydrogen States in n-Type InN
items.abstract: Hydrogen often exhibits amphoteric behavior in semiconductors, but its role is in n-type InN remains unresolved. Wurtzite InN is a narrow-gap semiconductor with high electron mobility and is therefore attractive for high-speed electronics and optoelectronic applications. Here we use hard x-ray photoemission spectroscopy (HAXPES) to probe hydrogen-related electronic structure in as-grown and post-annealed InN thin films prepared at different grown temperatures. Post annealing, which reduces the concentration of hydrogen impurities in the films, shifts the core-level spectra toward lower binding energy, consistent with a chemical-potential shift associated with the passivation of electron carriers. items.title: Designing Strong and Broadband Nonreciprocal Thermal Radiation in Magnetic Topological Materials
items.abstract: Breaking reciprocity in thermal radiation opens opportunities for energy harvesting, sensing, and thermal management. Traditional nonreciprocal radiative semiconductor devices need external magnetic field. In this work, we predict a series of magnetic topological materials for magnetic-field-free nonreciprocal thermal radiation in the infrared regime, by combining first-principles calculations with Maxwell electrodynamics. We find strong and broadband nonreciprocity in magnetic Weyl semimetals (e.g., Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$), outperforming the conventional semiconductor such as InAs. Furthermore, we propose universal material design recipes: strong nonreciprocity requires a large anomalous Hall response relative to the optical loss, whereas the broadband response favors large optical loss and small dielectric dispersion.
